system.description: When a creature's spell includes you among its targets, the caster may spend up to (SL) HP: you recover 2 HP per HP spent, or shed one status per 3 HP. When an offensive spell includes you, you may spend up to (SL) HP to deal 2 dark damage per HP back at the caster — 3 per HP at level 40+.
